Class SolverSingleClosedExact

java.lang.Object
solvers.Solver
solvers.singleSolverAlgorithms.SolverSingleClosedExact
Direct Known Subclasses:
SolverSingleClosedExactDyn
public class SolverSingleClosedExact extends Solver
Solves a single class closed model using the normalisation constant algorithm, one of the exact solution techniques available in JMVA for closed product form queueing networks. A preordering algorithm is applied to obtain a numerically stable network before the solution.
Author:
Federico Granata
